title: Machine learning-based prediction of short-term outcomes in aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage: a multicenter study integrating clinical and inflammatory indicators.
summary: Development data came from four tertiary hospitals (1,120 patients), with a separate 326-patient Second Xiangya validation set; of six algorithms, the gradient boosting machine reached AUC 0.895 internally and 0.864 on that separate site. The authors describe the external site as quasi-external, prospective validation is still needed, and clinical impact is not established.
